solar_geometry.shadow_consistency: Consistent. SPICE ray-tracing of the circular end-face shadow onto the inclined regolith bed reconstructs a diameter of 10.76-11.65 mm, precisely matching the 11.14 mm cylinder diameter.

front_face_morphology.conclusion: The front face has zero flat facets and zero polygonal vertices. It is a smooth, continuous closed circular curve.

barrel_photometry.azimuthal_gradient: Continuous, smooth cylindrical roll-off (R2 = 0.9985). Zero step discontinuities or planar facet brightness jumps.

geological_refutation.ventifact_mechanics: Saltation impact abrasion produces asymmetric Dreikanter/Einkanter with sharp keels, or rounded convex cobbles (Sternberg's Law). No fluid boundary layer acts as a mechanical lathe to machine an axisymmetric cylinder with parallel generators and perpendicular planar end caps.
geological_refutation.diagenetic_concretions: Gale Crater concretions have aspect ratio ~ 1.0 (+12 sigma difference). Terrestrial pipe concretions have corrugated bulbous rinds and hollow tubes.
geological_refutation.local_stratigraphy: Mirador formation sandstones in Paraitepuy Pass fracture into tabular slabs and equant angular pebbles (mean aspect ratio 1.23, flank R2 0.104). Sol 3556 ranks 1/21 in both dimensions (+12 sigma aspect ratio, +10.7 sigma linearity).

scientific_conclusion: The Sol 3556 anomaly is uniquely consistent with an engineered right circular cylinder (D = 11.14 mm, L = 31.60 mm, aspect ratio 2.83). Alternative hypotheses (hexagonal prism, fracture slab, tapered cone) are physically and morphologically ruled out: the front face has zero flat facets (hexagon radial error is 33% higher, square error is 183% higher), the barrel has smooth continuous azimuthal curvature, and the cast shadow matches SPICE solar projection of a circular disc. Natural geological mechanisms (ventifaction, diagenetic concretions, columnar jointing) are refuted by the physical laws of saltation abrasion and Gale Crater stratigraphy.
